title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via YAML.unsafe_load (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, YAML.unsafe_load reconstructs objects from untrusted bytes and lets the payload name the classes that run. A crafted stream can therefore execute code during construction. Use a data-only format, or an explicit allowlist (YAML.safe_load), and authenticate the payload before parsing it.
applicability: ruby services that deserialize stored or networked data; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution when the stream is attacker influenced; HIGH severity.
